name: arest-mcp-registry
description: The MCP router's own store: which apps it serves, where each package is, and whether to start it. Compiled like any app -- compile.js over the metamodel and these readings -- and read by the daemon's start with bun:sqlite, one select over the App table. There is no `mcp` script: nothing calls a verb on the registry, so it composes no module and starts no server. The check removes store.db before rebuilding it, because nothing writes this store at runtime and a row the readings no longer assert is a deletion rather than a runtime write -- readings/apps.md says why in full.

scripts.check: mkdir -p .check && rm -f .check/store.db && AREST_OUT_DIR=$PWD/.check AREST_DB=$PWD/.check/store.db bun ../compile.js ../../../metamodel readings
